ZHIJIANG_KEYWORD_YANG.title: Yang
ZHIJIANG_KEYWORD_YANG.description: [gold]Yang[/gold] card. Bella is in the [gold]Bai La[/gold] state when [gold]Yang[/gold] cards outnumber [gold]Yin[/gold] cards. The [gold]Yin-Yang[/gold] difference is the gap between the number of [gold]Yang[/gold] and [gold]Yin[/gold] cards.
ZHIJIANG_KEYWORD_YIN.title: Yin
ZHIJIANG_KEYWORD_YIN.description: [gold]Yin[/gold] card. Bella is in the [gold]Hei La[/gold] state when [gold]Yin[/gold] cards outnumber [gold]Yang[/gold] cards. The [gold]Yin-Yang[/gold] difference is the gap between the number of [gold]Yang[/gold] and [gold]Yin[/gold] cards.
